segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

Following up on the calibration workspace quote for the three plants. Current draft is 48 seats, annual term starting July 15, with implementation at $6,000 one-time. Total subscription is $51,840 for year one.

I also attached the rollout checklist for the lab leads.

Best,
Evan

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Hi Evan,

Thanks. We are closer, but I need to keep this under $45k if possible. Finance is also asking whether the 48 seats can be split 20/16/12 by site for the invoice coding.

Go-live target is still 8/5, assuming IT gets the SSO info this week.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yeah, so the seat split is fine. We can show 20 for Dayton, 16 for Mesa, 12 for Allentown on the order form and still keep one admin console.

On timing, if we have signature by 6/28, our services team can hold the 7/22 kickoff and the 8/5 go-live should be okay.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
That works on the sites.

Can you confirm what the actual year-one number would be? I have a budget review at 2 pm today and need one number, not list plus assumptions.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Per our text thread, we can do $42,900 for year one on the 48 seats, provided signature is in by Friday. I’ll get deal desk cleaned up after and have the paperwork match that number before it goes to billing.

Implementation stays at $6,000, so the combined first invoice would be $48,900 plus applicable tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Ok, use that.

Please make the first invoice due net 30 from 7/15, not from signature date. Also add our PO number 78441 when you send the final.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Got it. I’ll set subscription start to 7/15, invoice terms net 30, PO 78441, and the site allocation as noted.

Do you want procurement or legal as the signer? Last time Jamie signed the pilot amendment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Jamie can sign. Copy procurement on the envelope though: procurement@northfieldlabs.example.

If you can send by noon tomorrow, I can get it in the Friday batch.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Will do. I’ll send the order form tomorrow morning with Jamie as signer and procurement copied.

Implementation kickoff remains held for 7/22 pending signature.
